title: Yellow Crisp Chinese Squid Salt And Pepper Squid
description: A bitter and crisp Chinese dish featuring ginger cordial and soffritto-base, served in a dolsot stone bowl. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is a quick-fix solution for a delicious meal.

ingredients.name: squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the squid and cook for 2-3 minutes until browned and crispy.
Add the soffritto-base and cook for 1 minute until heated through.
Add the ginger cordial and cook for 1 minute until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the squid mixture to a dolsot stone bowl.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
